text:
maya_csm: Kicking off Sapphire pilot onboarding. Customer leads: Tara (PM) + Luis (infra). Goal: pilot Redwood embeddings + chat for triage and routing. Target: 30-day window.

ravi_se: Infra Q — are they blocking egress from staging? Need allowlist early if so.

maya_csm: Tara says staging allows outbound to hosted endpoints; prod may need VPC/Dedicated later. We'll start hosted.

elaine_enablement: Plan two workshops: 1) integration + runbook, 2) evals & alerting. Recommend product + infra + 1 support SME attend.

samir_successops: Renewal risk: small pilot budget. Add triggers: <55% planned test traffic by D12 or eval pass <80%. We'll send weekly traction to their exec sponsor.

ravi_se: Quick tech checklist:
- API key exchange & allowlist steps
- Anonymized support transcripts
- Golden-answer eval set
- Staging replay (5k) for p95 testing (target <350ms)

maya_csm: Draft timeline: D0 kickoff; D0-5 env prep/data; D6-12 integration + smoke tests; D13-19 enablement + evals; D20-30 polish + go/no-go.

elaine_enablement: I'll draft runbook + short pre-read and share before workshop.

ravi_se: I'll post curl examples + minimal test harness tonight.

onboard-bot: Meeting created: "Sapphire Pilot Kickoff" 2024-04-08 11:00 PDT — invites sent to maya_csm, ravi_se, elaine_enablement, tara_sapphire.

maya_csm: Success criteria (confirm): integration completed; >=80% correctness on evals; p95 <350ms; customer can run daily evals and see regressions. D30 decision checkpoint: go/no-go + recommended commercial path.

samir_successops: Owner notes: I'll own weekly report + dashboard. Adding D12 alert for low traffic.

maya_csm: Owners: integration=ravi_se; enablement=elaine_enablement; metrics=samir_successops; CSM=maya_csm.

elaine_enablement: Action recap: runbook + pre-read (Elaine, by Mon).

ravi_se: Test harness + curl examples (Ravi, EOD).

samir_successops: Dashboard draft + weekly template (Samir, Wed).

maya_csm: I'll finalize agenda and attendee list before the call. Thanks team :raised_hands:
